summary.intent: Fix unsigned commits across a stacked PR chain by re-signing and force-pushing, then continue the release-notes work by adding a `version --emit-preview` flag and composing the release PR body from it, with all commits signed so PRs can merge.
summary.outcome: Re-signed eight commits across three branches (#463, #464, #466) and force-pushed with lease after verifying identical trees; GitHub reported the two sampled commits as verified. Implemented `version --emit-preview`, `compose-pr-body --preview`, the action script reorder, tests, docs/specs and a changeset on branch feat/emit-release-preview, then made a commit whose signature status was checked via `git log %G?` but whose result isn't shown in the transcript.

repo: Stacked PRs: #463 -> main, #464 -> #463, #466 -> #464. Re-signing the stack was done with `git rebase --update-refs --exec 'git commit --amend --no-edit -S'` onto origin/main, which rewrites all branches in the chain at once.
Signed commits are required for PRs to merge in this repo; after pushing, check `commit.verification.verified` and `.reason` via `gh api repos/orin-dx/callisto/commits/<sha>`.

Adding a field to CLI arg structs such as `VersionArgs` and `ComposePrBodyArgs` breaks many struct-literal initializers in `crates/callisto-cli/tests/*.rs` and in cli.rs (`emit_decision: None` sites), so each needs `emit_preview: None`.

`.github/tests/verify-release-workflow-contract.sh` pins the exact `command+=` line of the release workflow, so changing the action script requires updating this contract. The action script also has its own test, `.github/actions/callisto-action/tests/test_release_pr_contract.sh`.

New CLI behaviors need coordinated updates across the model (`callisto-graph/src/release_preview.rs`), graph commands (`commands/mod.rs`, `pr_body.rs`), the CLI (`cli.rs`, `commands/version.rs`, `commands/compose_pr_body.rs`), the error code (`error.rs` and `docs/errors.md`), specs (`docs/specs/cli.json`, `release.json`, `versioning.json`), `docs/architecture/versioning.md`, and a `.changeset` file.
The plan file `.claude/plans/PLAN-release-notes.md` tracks the stacked work and was updated with the in-progress status of feat/emit-release-preview.

Local verification gate used: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p callisto-graph -p callisto-cli --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps --workspace`, and `cargo test -p callisto-graph -p callisto-cli`.

code.finding: Pins the exact `command+=` line for the release workflow; it had to be edited when the action script's compose-pr-body invocation changed.
Release PR body composition lives here; it was reordered so the body is composed after the version step using the emitted preview.
Error code definitions were inspected here when adding a new error code for the emit-preview feature; the matching docs entry goes in docs/errors.md.

friction: The earlier commits were unsigned, which forced a rewrite of history and force-pushes of three branches; this resets CI, gates and possibly approvals on the PRs.
Adding `emit_preview` to the args structs required several rounds of fixing test initializers (partial_run_tests, lifecycle_e2e_tests, single_package_root_tests) before clippy passed.
The first run of the new emit_preview_tests failed and needed two edits before the key equality test passed.
The release-pr contract test and the workflow contract test failed after the action script change and had to be updated.
Only two of the eight re-signed commits were spot-checked through the GitHub API, so verification of the rest remains unconfirmed.
open_items: The signature status of the new feat/emit-release-preview commit still needs confirming (`%G?` output was not shown), and it must be pushed with a verified signature and opened as a PR stacked appropriately.
Remaining plan item: the 'Merging will publish' section and verdict in the PR body, which should read `release --dry-run --format json` run after version.
Finding `01M6T6QNY4G4` still needs to be resolved by the user.
PR approvals may need to be re-obtained after the force-push, and CI and gates must re-run on #463, #464 and #466.
The remaining six re-signed commits have not been verified on GitHub.
